lessons: A small, steady gain was locked in by following the rule exit.
FX fees took about a third of the gross profit on this small position.

answers.what_happened: Bought at 444.85 on Nov 6. AMD rallied on AI partnership news and an analyst top-pick call to about 562. The rank-buffer rule dropped AMD at Nov 12 pre-market, and the rule_exit sold at 561.34. Profit C$7.49 after C$1.04 of fees, about +24%, held 6 days. Minutes later the plain momentum rule re-bought AMD at 562.30.

lessons: Buying after a crash paused worked here, with small sizing limiting the risk.
Two overlapping rules can sell and re-buy the same stock within minutes, paying FX fees twice.

mistakes.description: Churn between the two momentum rules: sold AMD at 561.34 and re-bought at 562.30 the same morning, paying about 3% in FX fees for no change in exposure. A system-design issue waiting on Stellan's decision, not a rule break.

answers.what_happened: Bought at 168.75 on Nov 5. Exxon traded mostly sideways (about 164-170) as WTI oil fell from about 99.6 to 89.6. The two momentum rules disagreeing produces sell-and-rebuy churn on the same stock.
